about: The answers of one cluster of Camunda 8 to the reads of the screens Pulse's surfaces share, under /v2, recorded in one run on 2026-11-21 from the world C8WorldSeed seeds on camunda/camunda:8.10.9 with H2 and no security, and the screens every Camunda 8 wire of Pulse builds from them at asOf, in the JSON form of @miragon/pulse-screens: the engine screen; the instance screens of DSP-3001, which waits at its call activity for the incident of the instance it called, and of that called instance; the process screens of pulse-order at its latest version and at its version 1 and of pulse-dispatch, whose call activity waits for that incident; the first page of every instance of pulse-order's version 1, running and ended, with the counts of each scope; and what the finder finds by the business key ORD-1003, that ended instance, and by the key of the instance DSP-3001 called, which runs with its incident and carries its caller's business id DSP-3001, as Camunda 8 hands a called instance its caller's. Every key the answers name is this cluster's, so the screens read the same instances and versions.
